exposure: maternal glycated hemoglobin A1c (HbA1c) levels before delivery
maternal HbA1c levels between 20 and 24 weeks' gestation
maternal HbA1c levels in the first trimester
outcome: low arterial pH values (pH <7.10) in infants
cohort: The study included data from 789 women with type 1 diabetes and their infants.
finding: Higher maternal HbA1c levels before delivery and between 20 and 24 weeks' gestation, along with urgent cesarean section, were significantly associated with low umbilical artery pH in infants of mothers with type 1 diabetes.
mod_finding: Urgent cesarean section was associated with low umbilical artery pH, independently of maternal HbA1c levels.
